content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIM Nagpur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: IIM Nagpur Executive Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Nagpur Executive - Academic Office Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Nagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Nagpur Executive – Academic Office position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Executive – Academic Office post at IIM Nagpur is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: A Graduate degree with first class or equivalent is the minimum qualification. A Post-graduate degree with 55% marks is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Executive – Academic Office position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Executive – Academic Office role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will primarily involve an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Executive – Academic Office post is on a Contract basis.

faq.question: Q7. Where is IIM Nagpur located?
faq.answer: IIM Nagpur is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from other states apply for this job?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions, so candidates from other states may be eligible to apply if they meet the criteria.

faq.question: Q9. How can I get the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIM Nagpur?
faq.answer: The official website of IIM Nagpur is www.iimnagpur.ac.in, which is also provided in the 'Important Links' section.
